items.title: Who would you rather have: Dyson Daniels at 4 years/$100M or Ausar Thompson at 5 years/$155M
items.author: DeanBlandino2
items.body_excerpt: They're pretty much the same age. Daniels is like 6 weeks younger than Ausar. Looking mostly at the last two seasons, considering Daniels leveled up his game after getting traded to Atlanta, there's a lot of similarities, and a few key differences. Ausar takes A LOT of shots…
